model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different model variants. The x-axis represents the number of completions (*k*), displayed on a logarithmic (base-2) scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick labels at each power of two. The y-axis represents coverage on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.40 to 0.90, with gridlines visible at 0.40, 0.60, 0.80, and approximately 0.90. Four lines are shown. The dark blue solid line with filled circle markers represents "Llama-3B," starting at approximately 0.43 at k = 2⁰ and rising steadily to approximately 0.90 at k = 2⁸. The green dashed line with filled square markers represents "Llama-3B + FT," starting at approximately 0.48 at k = 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.90 at k = 2⁸, generally tracking close to or slightly above the Llama-3B line at lower k values before converging at higher k values. The light blue solid line with open circle markers represents "Llama-1B," starting at approximately 0.42 at k = 2⁰ and rising to approximately 0.88 at k = 2⁸, remaining slightly below the 3B variants across most of the range. The light green solid line with open triangle markers represents "Llama-1B + FT," starting at approximately 0.45 at k = 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.88 at k = 2⁸, following a similar trajectory to Llama-1B but slightly higher at lower k values. All four lines exhibit a monotonically increasing trend that decelerates at higher values of k, with the steepest gains occurring between k = 2⁰ and k = 2⁴.
